timeline.title: Ola Electric Q2 revenue falls 39%
timeline.line: Loss of ₹362 crore is narrower than a year ago but wider than Q1's ₹336 crore
more: Revenue fell to ₹421 crore from ₹690 crore
Kotak had estimated revenue of ₹507 crore and a ₹315.3 crore loss
